risk_register.title: Replication requires the third-party 'brl' (Bias-Reduced Linearization) Stata/SAS component not bundled by the authors
risk_register.evidence: Transparency Trail: 'the command brl went unrecognized and ... the package brl was installed from https://economics.byu.edu/faculty-and-staff/frandsen/software'. brl.ado (Stata) / brl.sas are separate from the paper but were mirrored in the OSF code node. Running table-2/4.do out-of-the-box on a stock Stata fails until brl is installed.
risk_register.impact: Reproducibility friction only; the human PBR produced exact results after installing brl, and this audit independently re-derived the BRL SE from brl.ado (0.0472902). Not a substantive error.
risk_register.fix: Bundle/version-pin the brl ado-file and document the Frandsen source; add a container/environment manifest.

risk_register.title: Hard-coded absolute Windows working directories and path edits required in do-files/SAS
risk_register.evidence: table-2.do, table-4.do contain 'cd "W:\Student bonuses\Yannay Aug 08\data"'; table8_linear_quart.sas has libname home/target pointing at the same W: path; the PBR analysts had to edit these and rename a 'cap erase' to keep estimates. table-2/4.do also erase their output .dta at the end (needed a PBR stop-line edit).
risk_register.impact: Not push-button reproducible without path edits; minor friction, no numerical discrepancy.
risk_register.fix: Use project-relative paths and remove destructive final 'cap erase' of primary output tables.
